result.description: AI meeting recorder/notes platform; public API reads and manages recordings, transcripts, highlights, uploads, and webhooks.
result.auth_detail: REST API v2: OAuth2 Authorization Code with required PKCE (client_id/secret requested manually; public clients such as MCP and native apps can use an HTTPS URL as client_id). Personal Access Token (any plan) and Workspace Access Token (admin only, Business/Enterprise), both sent as Authorization: Bearer plus a Public-Api-Version header. The `workspace` OAuth scope needs a client verified by Grain.
result.access_detail: A PAT is available on every plan including Free, so a developer can self-serve it. For end-user connect via OAuth, confirmed docs: HTTPS-URL client_id for public clients with no approval needed; server-side clients need a client_id and secret requested manually (undocumented process). The workspace scope and the WAT need a Business/Enterprise plan, and the OAuth workspace scope also needs Grain verification. No sandbox.
result.api_notes: REST v2 under api.grain.com/_/public-api/v2. Covers recordings (list/get/rename/download), transcripts (JSON/txt/vtt/srt), tags, sharing, clips, stories, playlists CRUD, uploads, webhooks (hooks), users, teams, meeting types, and token-info. Rate limit 300 requests/min per token. v1 beta sunset.
result.blocker: Server-side OAuth client credentials are requested manually from Grain; the workspace scope needs Grain verification; the workspace token needs a Business/Enterprise plan. PAT is self-serve on any plan.

evidence.quote: The Grain API lets you read and manage recordings, highlights, uploads, and more.
The API supports a standard OAuth2 Authorization Code flow, including the PKCE extension
At least one redirect URI is required to register a new client.
Public clients, such as MCP clients and native apps, can skip Step 1 by using an HTTPS URL as their client_id.
The `workspace` scope is only available to clients verified by Grain.
Available on every plan, including Free.
Requires admin access to generate and is available on Business and Enterprise plans.
The Grain API lets developers read meeting data, manage recordings, and receive real-time events
The API allows 300 requests per minute per token.
Any MCP client that can send custom headers can connect with a Personal Access Token instead of OAuth.
